# `app` — top level

The routes outside the routers: the Grove's health, its source code offer, and the members' page and published website at every other address.

| Method | Path | Who may call | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|
| GET | [`/api/health`](#get-api-health) | Anyone | Whether the Grove is up, with its name and version. |
| GET | [`/api/source`](#get-api-source) | Anyone | The source code of this Grove (AGPL-3.0 section 13), as a zip. |
| GET, HEAD | [`/{path}`](#get-path) | Anyone | The members' page and its files; every other address is the Grove's published website, if it has one. |

<a id="get-api-health"></a>
### `GET /api/health`

Whether the Grove is up, with its name and version. Needs no sign-in.

- Handler: [`health`](../../../backend/api.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: JSON object with `status`, `name`, `version`

<a id="get-api-source"></a>
### `GET /api/source`

The source code of this Grove (AGPL-3.0 section 13), as a zip. Needs no sign-in.

- Handler: [`source_offer`](../../../backend/api.py)
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: a `application/zip` body

<a id="get-path"></a>
<a id="head-path"></a>
### `GET HEAD /{path}`

The members' page and its files; every other address is the Grove's published website, if it has one.

- Handler: [`frontend`](../../../backend/api.py)
- Not in the OpenAPI document
- Who may call: Anyone; no sign-in

**Response**

- `200`: `null`, or a file, typed by its name, or a raw body, with the upstream's type, or a redirect (307)
- `200`: a file, typed by its name
- `200`: a file, typed by its name, or a raw body, with the upstream's type, or `null`

**Errors** (plus the [request checks](../../API.md#errors) every route makes)

| Status | Detail | Raised in |
|---|---|---|
| 404 | Not Found | `frontend` |
